hint.en: Lifts the charge limit to 100% and sets the backup reserve target so the battery charges from the grid during a cheap window (e.g. Octopus Agile).
Lowers the backup reserve so the battery can discharge and enables grid feed-in, to export during a high-price window.
Grid = net flow to/from the grid (import positive, export negative). Home load = the total power your home is using right now (always positive).
